name: Clerk
description: Clerk's hosted server reads and manages users and organizations in your Clerk application and answers questions about wiring Clerk into code.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (clerk.clerk.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
